title: DOW-UAP-PR114, Unresolved UAP Report, Atlantic Ocean, 2016
what_is_it: A US government release consisting of a 39-second infrared video clip of an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), accompanied by an official metadata sheet and shot-by-shot video description.
interpretation_warnings: AARO explicitly states the video description is informational only and does not reflect any analytical judgement, investigative conclusion, or factual determination about the event's validity, nature, or significance.
Case is classified as unresolved — no identification of the object has been made.
No underlying PDF text was extractable; facts rely on the war.gov metadata and video description only.
The footage is a short 39-second clip from a single infrared sensor; there is no corroborating multi-sensor or eyewitness data in the release.
An 'area of contrast' on an infrared sensor is not confirmed to be a physical craft; it describes a thermal signature, which can have mundane explanations.
